Input:receiverName.title: receiverName
Input:receiverName.description: The customer contact name that should appear as the recipient of the email draft. Typically this is the Primary Contact associated with the Opportunity.

Input:openCases.title: openCases
Input:openCases.description: The number of currently open support cases associated with the Opportunities Account. Use this to identify customer concerns and personalise outreach.

Input:Opportunity.title: Opportunity
Input:Opportunity.description: the opportunity Id that in which the Prompt template is being draft for.

Input:AccountName.title: AccountName
Input:AccountName.description: The Account Name associated with the Opportunity. Use for personalisation and contextual references in the email content.

Input:emailTemplateType.title: emailTemplateType
Input:emailTemplateType.description: Template type selected by the Agent such as URGENT or NURTURING.

outputLanguage.title: Output language
outputLanguage.description: Optional. Specify the response language using the appropriate two-character language code or five-character locale code (for example, en_US, en_GB, es, es_MX).

isPreviewOnly.title: Preview Only
isPreviewOnly.description: Resolves the prompt template without generating an LLM response.
